keywordCapabilityUpdates.keyword: fractions on a number line worksheet

sourceReview.finding: Competitor describes reading fractions, mixed number points, equivalent fraction number lines and operations by jumps. R66 only claims the name-and-plot subskills.
Competitor displays options for plots, labels, number of lines, answer key and paper size. R66 implements identify/plot, line ranges, seeding and answer PDFs, not all competitor modes.
Competitor has printable identify-the-dot sheets and separate answer keys.
